name: Kamaliss MontAzure Phuket – MGallery Collection
short_description: A 150-room MGallery resort that opened in April 2026 within the MontAzure enclave above Kamala Beach, built around a signature lagoon and two restaurants.
ai_summary: Kamaliss MontAzure Phuket is an MGallery Collection resort that opened in April 2026 inside the MontAzure lifestyle community above Kamala Beach, about 300 metres from the sand. The 150-room property is arranged around a signature lagoon and two outdoor pools, with two restaurants (salt at six and SOLISS), a spa, and an eight-acre hillside setting positioned as a quieter alternative to Patong. Because the hotel only opened a few months ago, independent guest reviews and third-party coverage remain thin, so its reputation is still being established. Early marketing and hospitality-trade coverage emphasize a contemporary, wellness-oriented design aimed at couples and boutique-hotel travelers rather than large families.

faqs.question: When did Kamaliss MontAzure Phuket open?
faqs.answer: The resort opened in April 2026 as part of Accor's MGallery Collection, making it one of the newest hotels on this stretch of Phuket's west coast. Because it is so new, guest review volume is still building, so it's worth checking the latest ratings before booking.

faqs.question: Is Kamaliss MontAzure Phuket on the beach?
faqs.answer: Not directly -- it sits within the MontAzure community on the hillside above Kamala Beach, roughly 300 metres from the sand. Guests reach the beach on foot or via the community's internal pathways, and the resort's own lagoon and two pools serve as the main on-site water features.
